description: Contains definitions for version comparison, environment checks, and command resolution related to the 'gateway' component in the OpenClaw project, including semantics versions, environment status, and executable command generation.

classes.name: Semver
classes.description: Helper struct for semantic version comparison and parsing, supporting major.minor.patch format.

classes.name: GatewayEnvironmentKind
classes.description: Enumeration representing different states of the gateway environment status.

classes.name: GatewayEnvironmentStatus
classes.description: Struct representing the current status of the gateway environment, including version info and messages.

classes.name: GatewayCommandResolution
classes.description: Struct providing the resolved command to run the gateway and its environment status.

methods.name: Semver.parse
methods.description: Parses a version string into a Semver object if valid.

methods.name: Semver.compatible(with:)
methods.description: Checks if the current version is compatible with a required version (same major and not older).

methods.name: GatewayEnvironment.check
methods.description: Performs environment checks to determine gateway and node versions and status.

methods.name: GatewayEnvironment.resolveGatewayCommand
methods.description: Resolves the command needed to run the gateway based on environment and configuration.

methods.name: GatewayEnvironment.installGlobal
methods.description: Asynchronously installs a global version of 'openclaw' using npm/pnpm/bun.

methods.name: GatewayEnvironment.normalizeGatewayVersionOutput
methods.description: Normalizes the output string from a gateway version command.

methods.name: GatewayEnvironment.readGatewayVersion
methods.description: Reads and parses the version output of a gateway binary.

methods.name: GatewayEnvironment.readLocalGatewayVersion
methods.description: Reads and parses the local package.json version for the gateway.
